config.title: Marp Scroll Sync
config.autoFold: When a Marp source is opened, fold every slide except the one with the cursor. When the cursor moves to another slide, fold the previous slide and unfold the current one.
config.autoFoldKinds: Parts to keep folded even inside the open slide (style = the front-matter style: block and <style> elements, svg = inline SVG, notes = presenter notes).
config.slideLabels: Show "number | class | title ★" on the separator line of each slide (display only; nothing is written to the source).
config.panelLabels: Show faint region names (in Japanese, e.g. "◀ 左パネル" = left panel) at the end of lines such as <div class="left"> (display only; nothing is written to the source).
config.adaptivePaste: When pasting a slide copied from another deck, offer a paste option that adapts it to this deck (copies its assets, brings along deck-specific CSS, follows this deck's color palette).
config.saveAfterEdit: Save the file immediately after this extension writes to the source (direct edits on the preview, box moves, slide operations, inserts, marks, layout changes, size/color, etc.). An unsaved buffer can conflict with external tools that rewrite the same file on disk, such as AI coding assistants. Undo with Cmd+Z (Ctrl+Z) still works.
config.home.onStartup: When a folder containing theme/academic.css (marp-GUI) is opened and no Marp source is shown yet, open the Home screen (recent, shelves, most-edited, search).
config.home.openPreview: When a card on the Home screen opens a source, also open the synced preview beside it.
